title: More Tools Sets
description: Adds More Tools to Minecraft some with unique abilities.
body:
This mod adds various tools that can be crafted with Vanilla Items. No New ores or materials are added as you can use already Vanilla Minecraft items such as Dirt, Obisidian, Redstone, Lapis and more!



Each tool set varies on Durability, Damage, Attack Speed, and in the near future some tools will have abilities depending on the material used.



List of Tool Sets currently:

- Dirt
- Leather
- Lapis
- Copper
- Redstone
- Obsidian (Immune to Lava/Fire)
- Emerald
- Amethyst
- Magma (Sets Entities on fire for 10 Seconds, Immune to Lava/Fire)

There are also a few Advancements in the mod. You can also trade with the Toolsmith and Weaponsmith for the Emerald tools. The Wandering Trader will sometimes have Dirt Tools being sold for an Emerald.
